items.title: Automaker Ford eyes aerospace growth with minority bet on Revolution Space
items.summary: Investing.com -- Ford Motor Company (NYSE:F) has agreed to acquire a minority stake in U.S. defense contractor Revolution Space, extending its push to diversify revenue streams beyond traditional automotive manufacturing. Through its Industrial Platform LLC subsidiary, the Dearborn, Michigan-based automaker plans to lend its high-volume production expertise to help scale the startup’s next-generation spacecraft and propulsion systems.
